You deserve to know what you're putting on your skin - and where it came from. Born Essence is made in the USA, cruelty-free, and formulated with ethically sourced organic shea butter. No parabens. No synthetic fillers. No animal testing. When you choose Born Essence, you're choosing a product that respects both your skin and the people behind it. Why you should use Born Essence Everything You Need to Know Will this leave my dark skin looking ashy? No. The fast-absorbing formula is specifically designed to absorb completely without leaving white residue or an ashy cast. Customers with deep skin tones consistently report this as the reason they keep coming back. How long does the hydration last? One application in the morning will keep most skin types hydrated through the day. If you have very dry skin or live in a dry climate, a second application before bed will lock in overnight. Our customers with dry skin tell us they stopped reaching for their lotion midday after switching to Born Essence. Is Born Essence worth the price? We think so - and so do our customers. At $19.99, Born Essence costs less per ounce than most premium shea lotions, and significantly less than the $35–$45 options you'll find at Sephora or Ulta for comparable natural-ingredient formulas. One bottle, used daily, typically lasts 4–6 weeks. That's under $5 a week for all-day hydration that actually works. What makes Born Essence different from other shea butter lotions? Most shea butter lotions use shea as a minor ingredient buried deep in the formula. Born Essence leads with Butyrospermum Parkii (shea butter) as the second ingredient after water - meaning you're getting a real shea lotion, not a marketing claim. Combined with phytoceramides, Vitamin E, and a clean, preservative-free base, the formula delivers noticeably different results than drugstore alternatives. Is Born Essence Shea Butter Lotion suitable for all skin types? Yes, Born Essence Shea Butter Lotion is suitable for dry, oily, combination, and normal skin types. It's easily absorbed by the skin, leaving a protective layer for long-lasting protection without clogging pores or causing breakouts.
